paite: Huan huai nung in hichi ahong hi a, David in Philistia mite sual in azou hi. Huchi in David in Philistia mite khut a pan Metheg-ammah alaksak hi.
heading: David Vualzohnate / (1 Kro 18.1-17)
english: After this, David struck the Philistines and subdued them; and David took the bridle of the mother city out of the hand of the Philistines.

paite: Moab mite asual a, lei a lumsak in khau in ateh a; vual nih athat a, vual khat bel ahinghawi hi. Huchi in Moab mite David sikhate ahong hita ua, thilpiakte ahon tawi uhi.
english: He defeated Moab, and measured them with the line, making them to lie down on the ground; and he measured two lines to put to death, and one full line to keep alive. The Moabites became servants to David, and brought tribute.

paite: David in Euphrates Luipi a, gam la nawn dia hoh in Zobah kumpipa Rehob tapa Hadadezer leng athat hi.
english: David also struck Hadadezer the son of Rehob, king of Zobah, as he went to recover his dominion at the River.

paite: Huchi in David in asakol tungtuangmi sangkhat-le-zasagih leh lei sepaih singnih amatsak hi. Huchi in kangtalai kai ding zakhat chih louh sakol tengteng athagui uh asattansak hi.
english: David took from him one thousand seven hundred horsemen and twenty thousand footmen. David hamstrung the chariot horses, but reserved enough of them for one hundred chariots.

paite: Damaskas a Siria mite Zobah kumpipa Hadadezer huh dia kuante David in Siria mite lak a mi singnih-le-sangnih athat hi.
english: When the Syrians of Damascus came to help Hadadezer king of Zobah, David struck twenty two thousand men of the Syrians.

paite: Huchi in David in Siria gam a Damaskas ah sepaih akoih hi. Siria mite David sikhate ahong hita ua, siah aliau uhi. TOUPA'N ahohna peuh ah David avualzousak zel hi.
english: Then David put garrisons in Syria of Damascus; and the Syrians became servants to David, and brought tribute. Yahweh gave victory to David wherever he went.

paite: David in Hadadezer pawlte dangka-eng lumte alaksak a, Jerusalem ah apaipih hi.
english: David took the shields of gold that were on the servants of Hadadezer, and brought them to Jerusalem.

paite: Hadadezer khopite Betah leh Berothai a pan David in dal tampi ala hi.
english: From Betah and from Berothai, cities of Hadadezer, King David took a great quantity of bronze.

paite: Hamath kumpipa Toi in Hadadezer sepaih tengteng David in azou chih azak in,
english: When Toi king of Hamath heard that David had struck all the army of Hadadezer,

paite: Hadadezer asual a, azou chih azak in chibai buk ding leh vualzawl ding in Toi in David kiang ah atapa Joram asawl a; David in lah Hadadezer dou in ana that khinta hi. Huchi in Joram in dangka belte, dangka-eng belte leh dal belte ahon tawi hi.
english: then Toi sent Joram his son to King David to greet him and to bless him, because he had fought against Hadadezer and struck him; for Hadadezer had wars with Toi. Joram brought with him vessels of silver, vessels of gold, and vessels of bronze.

paite: Huaite leh namdang azoh tengteng a pan alak dangka leh dangka-eng kumpipa David in TOUPA kiang ah alan hi:
english: King David also dedicated these to Yahweh, with the silver and gold that he dedicated of all the nations which he subdued—

paite: Siriate, Moabte, Ammon suante, Philistiate, Amalekte leh Zobah kumpipa Rehob tapa Hadadezer a kipan agallakte.
english: of Syria, of Moab, of the children of Ammon, of the Philistines, of Amalek, and of the plunder of Hadadezer, son of Rehob, king of Zobah.

paite: David in Chi Phaizang ah Siria mi singkhat-le-sanggiat ava that a, apailam in aminthangta hi.
english: David earned a reputation when he returned from striking down eighteen thousand men of the Syrians in the Valley of Salt.

paite: Edom ah sepaih akoih a; Edom gam teng ah sepaih akoih hi. Huchi in Edom mi tengteng David sikha ahong hita uh. Huchi in TOUPA'N David apaina peuh ah avualzousak hi.
english: He put garrisons in Edom. Throughout all Edom, he put garrisons, and all the Edomites became servants to David. Yahweh gave victory to David wherever he went.

paite: Huchi in David in Israel mi tengteng tung ah vai ahawm a; David in ami tengteng tung ah diktattak in vai ahawm hi.
english: David reigned over all Israel; and David executed justice and righteousness for all his people.

paite: Zeruiah tapa Joab sepaih heutupen ahi. Ahilud tapa Jehoshaphat bel tanchin gelhpa ahi.
english: Joab the son of Zeruiah was over the army, Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was recorder,

paite: Ahitub tapa Zadok leh Abiathar tapa Ahimelek siampute ahi ua; Seraiah bel laigelhmi ahi.
english: Zadok the son of Ahitub and Ahimelech the son of Abiathar were priests, Seraiah was scribe,

paite: Jehoiada tapa Benaiah Kereth mi leh Pelet mite heutu ahi ua, David tapate bel vaihawmtu liante ahi uh.
english: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and the Pelethites; and David’s sons were chief ministers.
